verdict.rationale: Dashboards and widgets for reporting on project progress are a fair axis for a work-management product like Asana, but the evidence pack never documents a native dashboard or widget builder. The closest items do not count: an API tutorial for building your own status-update report app is a developer building block, MCP-generated reports and summaries are an adjacent feature, and exporting to a BI tool via Fivetran is a third-party workaround.
